summary: W3.1 corrected Mutation-Triggered Live Vector Integration handoff: W3.1 is not accepted by historical manual post-mutation embedding evidence. Acceptance now requires one applySystemArchitectureMutation write call whose success path automatically invokes the embedding lifecycle from actual touchedElementIds, touchedRelationshipIds, and touchedViewIds, then returns embeddingLifecycle and alignment in the MCP mutation response after real approved Qwen embedding and Neo4j vector-query proof.
notes: Selected viewpoint frame: Implementation and Migration Viewpoint. Stakeholder concern: requirements owners, ICT architects, implementation designers, runtime owners, and acceptors need W3.1 delivery evidence integrated into the actual mutation write success path, not a Harness-created lifecycle after mutation. Purpose: deciding and handoff preparation.

Affected view bindings: grag-w31-integration-acceptance remains the Implementation and Migration Viewpoint instance for W3-to-W3.1-to-W4 sequencing and observable E2E acceptance; its concern and scope now require a single applySystemArchitectureMutation call to automatically trigger embeddingLifecycle and return alignment. grag-seven-wave-sequence and grag-delivery-impact-foundation remain contextual sequencing/impact views and are not changed by this correction.

Mutation summary: updated grag-wp-3-1 and grag-w31-integration-acceptance. The corrected graph states that historical manual post-mutation lifecycle evidence is insufficient; the mutation tool write success path must use actual touchedElementIds/touchedRelationshipIds/touchedViewIds, automatically invoke embeddingLifecycle, and return embeddingLifecycle plus alignment in the MCP mutation response.

Coverage proof: grag-wp-3-1 functionalPoint.W3-1-live-mutation-vector-e2e -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-W3-1-MutationEmbeddingVectorE2E; grag-index-lifecycle functionalPoint.DT-16-all-mutation-version-advance -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DT-16; grag-embedding-generation functionalPoint.TS-09-affected-record-generation -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-09-EmbeddingGeneration; grag-embedding-provider-adapter functionalPoint.TS-09-adapter-generation -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-09-EmbeddingProviderAdapter; grag-semantic-index functionalPoint.DT-16-versioned-vector-baseline -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DT-16-SemanticIndex; grag-alignment-constraint functionalPoint.DT-17-unaligned-semantic-rejection -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DT-17; grag-native-retrieval-service functionalPoint.TS-01-native -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-01-Native; grag-embedding-qualification functionalPoint.TS-06 -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-06 and functionalPoint.TS-06-provider-e2e -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-06-Provider-E2E; grag-credential-boundary functionalPoint.TS-07 -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-07 and functionalPoint.TS-07-provider-secret-isolation -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-TS-07-Provider-Secret-Isolation.

Release semantics: complete automatic mutation-triggered extraction, real Qwen embedding generation, vector persistence, version evidence, and Neo4j vector-query observation are required before Aligned. Provider failure, unapproved provider/model/dimensions, partial generation, partial persistence, vector-index write failure, or query verification failure marks Stale or Failed and prohibits pure semantic queries until restored to Aligned.

Live-provider boundary: W3.1 live E2E requires explicit opt-in in controlled local or protected CI, the approved provider profile qwen3.7-text-embedding at 1024 dimensions, approved secret sources for QWEN_KEY and ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_PASSWORD, and a disposable or protected Neo4j vector index. Offline fakes and manual post-mutation lifecycle execution may support development but cannot be reported as live W3.1 delivery evidence.

Downstream ImplementationDesign must revise implementation contracts and test ownership for tests/explicit/entries/runApplyMutationEmbeddingVectorE2E.js so the E2E performs exactly one mutation tool call, forbids Harness-added lifecycle execution, forbids preset expectedTouchedRecords, and asserts embeddingLifecycle/alignment from the MCP response based on actual touched ids.

Human approval evidence: the 2026-07-25 corrected user request explicitly rescinded previous W3.1 acceptance and directed this automatic mutation-triggered lifecycle boundary. The handoff schema does not allow an approvedByHuman field, so approval is recorded as schema-compliant acceptanceApproval.W3-1 on grag-wp-3-1 and in this note.
